title: pass the threshold
description: Only when you reach that level can you pass through that gate
body: This is an auxiliary mod designed to increase the game's difficulty, which can be used alongside modpacks. For instance, it's common to see many players speedrunning Minecraft or certain modpacks, which makes the gameplay rather dull. Many interesting modpacks deserve to be savored and understood in depth. To this end, this mod adds a restriction: players must reach a certain experience level to access two distinct dimensions in the vanilla game—the Nether and the End. By default, level 50 is required to enter the Nether, and level 100 for the End. Of course, you can modify these thresholds via commands to set them at your preferred values.
